purpose: Defines what makes an external authority artefact REPOSITORY_RESIDENT. A citation is not an artefact; this schema is the difference.

authority_id.note: Must match the id in petcare-platform scripts/governance/mvc_authorities.py.

document.note: Document title exactly as the authority table records it. Not normalised.

source_system.note: Where the rows were exported FROM, not where they now sit.

source_identity.note: Enough to re-fetch the same object. For Notion: page or data-source id and URL. An identity that cannot be re-fetched is not provenance.

source_last_edited_utc.note: The SOURCE's own timestamp. Distinct from export time: the gap between them is how stale the copy is.

content_sha256.note: Hash of the export file AS EXPORTED. Verified on every run.

row_count.note: The denominator this ingestion establishes. Counted from the export, never asserted independently of it.

id_field.note: The column carrying the source's own row identifiers.

original_ids_preserved.note: Ingestion copies. It does not renumber, merge, split, reformat or reconcile. Any of those is a separate, separately-evidenced act.

semantic_normalisation_applied.note: Fail closed if true. A normalised copy is a derivation, not the authority.

excluded_rows.note: Rows present in the source but excluded from row_count, each with its id and the reason. The 499 figure is stated as '500 authored less REQ-MVC-1, which is prose' — that exclusion must appear HERE, with its id, or the arithmetic is unauditable.

residency_rule.statement: An authority is REPOSITORY_RESIDENT only when a conforming directory exists AND the export file's sha256 equals content_sha256.
explicitly_insufficient: a document that names the authority in prose
a source_path in the authority table that resolves to a document citing it
an entry in a reference list
a row count quoted in a handoff or register
residency_rule.note: This list is the whole point. AUTH-01, AUTH-02 and AUTH-03 each satisfy every one of these and are resident by none of them: they appear in the repository only as three bullet lines under 'Authoritative references used' in PHASE1_SCOPE_GATES_ACCEPTANCE.md.
